parent_tips.before_reading: Preview 'Stomp! Stomp! Elephant' together. Ask: What do you think Ella will do? Look for short vowel words like: stomp, jump, bump, thump, stamp.
parent_tips.during_reading: Help your child sound out tricky words. Notice the short vowel pattern in words like stomp, jump, bump, thump, stamp. Encourage expression when reading!
parent_tips.after_reading: Discuss: What did Ella do? What happened at the end? What was your favorite part about the park?
